weeks.title: Baseline + positioning
weeks.practice: Choose 3 role families; collect 10 job descriptions; baseline Python, SQL and DSA mock; record current gaps.

weeks.title: Python coding round
weeks.practice: Strings, dict/set, functions, exceptions, typing; solve small coding tasks without IDE autocomplete.

weeks.title: Python backend round
weeks.practice: OOP, modules, testing, logging, HTTP, async/await, error handling.

weeks.title: SQL + data systems
weeks.practice: Joins, CTEs, window functions, indexes, transactions, schema design.
weeks.artifact: Timed SQL set + explained query plans

weeks.title: ML fundamentals
weeks.practice: Train/test split, leakage, overfitting, metrics, vectors, probability and linear models.

weeks.title: Neural nets + PyTorch
weeks.practice: Tensors, gradients, loss, optimization; compare training and inference.

weeks.title: LLM foundations
weeks.practice: Tokens, context, attention, transformer blocks, inference, sampling and hallucination.

weeks.title: Prompting + API patterns
weeks.practice: Structured output, tool calling, streaming, retries, rate limits, caching and provider abstraction.

weeks.title: Embeddings + vector search
weeks.practice: Embedding model choice, similarity, chunking, metadata and pgvector.

weeks.title: RAG architecture
weeks.practice: Ingestion, retrieval, context construction, citations, access control and abstention.

weeks.title: RAG debugging
weeks.practice: BM25 vs dense, hybrid search, reranking, chunking failures, query rewriting.

weeks.title: Evaluation
weeks.practice: Golden set, retrieval metrics, answer quality, faithfulness, regression and judge limitations.

weeks.title: Agent fundamentals
weeks.practice: Agent vs workflow, tool schema, state, stopping conditions, error handling.

weeks.title: Agent orchestration + MCP
weeks.practice: Stateful graphs, checkpoints, human approval, MCP concepts and tool permissions.

weeks.title: Agent reliability + security
weeks.practice: Prompt injection, untrusted data, sandboxing, budgets, tracing and evals.

weeks.title: Docker + cloud + LLMOps
weeks.practice: Containerization, CI/CD, logs, health checks, cost, latency and provider failures.

weeks.title: AI system design I
weeks.practice: Design a multi-tenant knowledge assistant; requirements, retrieval, security and freshness.

weeks.title: AI system design II + project defense
weeks.practice: Design a tool-using support agent; explain trade-offs and project failures.

weeks.title: Resume + company targeting
weeks.practice: Resume evidence, job matching, project README, role-specific preparation.

weeks.title: Coding and SQL mock loop
weeks.practice: Two timed coding rounds, one SQL round, revisit DSA error log.

weeks.title: GenAI technical mock loop
weeks.practice: RAG, agents, evaluation, safety, LLM fundamentals and practical debugging.

weeks.title: Full interview simulations
weeks.practice: One full loop: coding, system design, project, behavioral; revise weak topics.

weeks.title: Final review + applications
weeks.practice: Light revision, project walkthrough, role-specific notes, apply and schedule interviews.
